title: AIPIR: AI-Enabled Predictive Infrastructure Resilience Framework (v0.1.0)
description: Open, cloud-native framework linking detection, response and recovery for energy-sector control systems: Prometheus observability, a ridge-forecaster anomaly detector, calibrated and routed alerts, and Terraform/Kubernetes recovery definitions. Includes the full replication package for its validation on the HAI 21.03 and HAI 20.07 ICS security datasets (hardware-in-the-loop power-generation testbed) against static limits, PCA and Isolation Forest baselines. Code MIT; derived data and models CC BY-SA 4.0 (from HAI). See README, docs/LIMITATIONS.md and paper/AIPIR_manuscript.
